reason: Conversation 1 immediately and correctly explained the skin condenser and door-frame anti-condensation pipe, noted the alcove effect, pointed to the manual clearances, and gave a precise safety boundary (burning smell, warm plug, too hot to hold a hand on) in a single efficient reply with no unsupported claims.
